name: Priya Shah
role: Analyst. Mara's closest friend at work.
personality: Funny, generous, the office's emotional glue. Quietly terrified of being passed over. Will trade a small betrayal for a big promise, then hate herself for it.

signature.lighting: Warm and soft when she is being a friend; caught in cold side light when she is hiding something.
signature.gesture: Turns her phone face down when a conversation gets close; laughs a beat too quickly.
signature.posture: Leans towards people, shoulders slightly raised when nervous.

voice.notes: Bright mid-low register (~185 Hz median pitch measured).
voice.pace_note: Tuned to ~2.9 words/sec measured (LibriTTS-R speakers run fast at 1.0).
